body.title: Map the Codex mcp_tool_call item
body.summary: Give the Codex mapper in cli-adapter.ts a branch for mcp_tool_call items on item.completed only: set the event's mcp from server and tool, and when tool is exactly insrc_present set present from arguments.documents (an object, no JSON-string form); ignore item.started so a call declares once, and still declare when the item's status is failed. command_execution and tool_call items map as before. Tested against the pinned codex-mcp-tool-call.jsonl capture. The mapper stays pinned to codex-cli 0.162.1 with no drift warning.
acceptanceChecks: The pinned real capture maps to exactly one tool-call event with present set, from the completed item
A failed completed item still sets present
Another tool, a server-qualified tool name, or string arguments set no present, and command_execution and tool_call items map as before

tests.name: the pinned real Codex capture maps to exactly one tool-call event with present set to the declared documents, from the completed mcp_tool_call item and not the started one
a Codex mcp_tool_call insrc_present item with status failed still sets present
a Codex mcp_tool_call for another tool, a server-qualified tool name, or string arguments sets no present, and command_execution and tool_call items map as before
